projectDescription: A Material 3 Android app that helps users visualize and track the passage of time across day, week, month, and year with progress bars, home screen widgets, a calendar, tasks, events, and smart notifications.
keyFeatures: Visual progress bars for day, week, month, and year
Home screen Glance widgets (day, week, month, year progress)
Calendar view with week and month modes
Task management with priority levels (High, Medium, Low) and completion tracking
Smart notifications via AlarmManager for tasks and events
Room database persistence with Hilt dependency injection
Boot-complete receiver to reschedule alarms after reboot
publicApiSurface: Tasks(id, name, description, importance, notification, isCompleted, taskTime, createdAt)
Events(id, name, description, notification, eventNotificationTime, eventStartTime, eventEndTime, createdAt)
Routes: TimerScreen, CalendarScreen, WelcomeScreen, NotificationScreen, ShowFeaturesScreen, AboutScreen, PrivacyScreen
